text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — SEV3: embedding errors in eu-west (INC-2026-042). Started 2026-03-15T09:12Z. Pages: Priya M. (primary), Alex R. (secondary). Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-042

Priya M.: taking this. quick summary: customers hitting 502/504 from edge -> retries; throughput down ~40% in eu-west, p95 token latency up. Saw change to nginx config rolled at ~09:05Z that correlates with spike.

Alex R.: I can see the 502/504 surge in the embed router logs, upstream reported 504s from embedding-router-v2. Autoscaler didn't spin up extra pods during the spike — looks like a selector mismatch.

Miguel S.: that was my nginx rollout earlier this morning — rolling back now to previous image.

Priya M.: starting rollback of nginx config. I'm also disabling routing to the newest pool until we confirm health.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started (rollback job id: rb-6270001) at 2026-03-15T09:18Z.

Miguel S.: rollback finished on all eu-west nginx nodes at ~09:28Z.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback completed at 2026-03-15T09:28Z. Health checks passing (nginx 200).

Priya M.: verified downstream — error rate returned to baseline after ~09:30Z. Current status: mitigated (no active customer-impacting errors). Customer impact window ~09:12Z-09:28Z: approx 7% of embedding requests in eu-west saw 502/504 or elevated latency. No data lost. CS/Support notified.

Samir: items to follow up: 1) validate autoscaler labeling/selector so HPA can behave, 2) add preflight check for rollout tags, 3) postmortem + customer note. Assigning: Alex -> autoscaler validation + hotfix, Miguel -> PR to revert/config test + ensure CI blocks bad rollouts, Priya -> postmortem & CS sync.

Alex R.: starting autoscaler check now. quick findings: HPA target CPU/RPS looks fine, but deployment label mismatch meant the HPA selector didn't match pods created by the new rollout (selector used app:embed-router-v2, rollout used app:embed-router). I'll push label hotfix to make selector stable.

Priya M.: please include the command you used in the notes.

Alex R.: hotfix staged, will apply to eu-west after approvals. Patch id: hf-627-a. Also adding a short `kubectl` check to the runbook.

Priya M.: runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.example/embedding-502s (see section "Rollout preflight" and "Autoscaler validation"). Quick validation commands for next shift:
```
kubectl -n embeds get hpa embedding-router -o yaml
kubectl -n embeds get deploy embedding-router -o yaml | grep labels -A2
kubectl -n embeds get pods -l app=embedding-router -o wide
```

Miguel S.: opened PR #789 to add tag-enforcement tests to the rollout pipeline and a mandatory label check before promotion. CI job name: rollout-preflight-tags.

Priya M.: coverage/handoff: I'm handing off primary to Kelly L. for 09:45-17:45 UTC shift. Alex remains secondary for the shift.

Kelly L.: ack, I'll take primary. I'll watch eu-west for the next 6 hours and keep an eye on the HPA and error rate. Anything still firing?

Priya M.: nothing active right now. outstanding action items (short):
- Alex: push hotfix to deployment labels and confirm HPA picks up replicas.
- Miguel: merge PR #789 for preflight tag enforcement.
- Priya: draft postmortem and customer impact note; include CS timeline.
- Samir: schedule a short retro to confirm rollout guardrails.

Priya M.: tl;dr: root cause = nginx rollout + label mismatch preventing autoscaler reaction. mitigation = rollback of nginx + hotfix for labels. impact = transient (7% of embeddings in eu-west), no data loss. next up: hotfix, CI preflight, postmortem.

Kelly L.: thanks, on it. I'll confirm autoscaler behavior within the hour and report if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

Priya M.: off shift, leaving monitoring to Kelly/Alex. I'll join postmortem draft later today. :wave:

incident-bot: Handoff thread closed by Priya M. at 2026-03-15T09:45Z.
